objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every pull_request/push workflow got a deliberate decision, the schedule/issue workflows were correctly identified as path-filter-inapplicable, and the required `unit-tests` check was given exactly the one shape that works — a single workflow with no workflow-level paths, gating the real steps via a computed `if:` output, with no second workflow duplicating the check name.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: The listed paths closely match what each workflow consumes (docs build inputs, deploy runtime deps, test sources/tests), but deploy.yml and docs-site.yml omit their own workflow files from their paths (a change to those workflows wouldn't trigger them), whereas tests.yml's internal filter correctly includes its own file.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The agent left the schedule-only and issue-driven workflows untouched, did not touch the branch-protection ruleset, and added only the minimal, necessary `pull-requests: read` permission required by the paths-filter action.
